title: Ali Hamed – Creative Investing  - [Invest Like the Best, EP.71]
summary: But the key word in that last sentence isn’t alpha, it’s earning. The conversation, with a 26-year old investor named Ali Hamed, serves as an example of what’s possible when you think creatively. Ali views the world with a fresh set of eyes, and has already become an expert at identifying new investment opportunities where others have not.

thesis: The episode argues that Microsoft faces a strategic constraint in adopting blockchain due to potential conflicts with its existing business, while the speaker holds a bearish view on Coinbase based on the belief that governments will not permit Bitcoin to function as a currency because it competes with sovereign money.
